description: This file defines a custom exception class `ConnectionNotAccessibleException` used within the Eclipse Ditto project to represent scenarios where a connection is not accessible or does not exist. It includes methods for creating instances, especially from JSON, and a builder class for constructing the exception with specific details.

classes.name: ConnectionNotAccessibleException
classes.description: A final class extending DittoRuntimeException, representing an exception when a specific connection cannot be accessed.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Returns a builder object for constructing a new instance of ConnectionNotAccessibleException with specific connection ID.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance of ConnectionNotAccessibleException from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a copy of the exception with different DittoHeaders.

inner_classes.name: Builder
inner_classes.description: A builder class for fluently constructing instances of ConnectionNotAccessibleException, with support for setting message, description, cause, and href.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance for this exception type using a given connection ID.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Parses a JSON object to instantiate this exception, extracting message and other details.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with the specified headers.
